label: 216.Indian_Roller
summary: The Indian Roller (Coracias roller) is an avian species characterized by specialized plumage and foraging adaptations. It primarily inhabits cultivated farmland, scrub forests, and grassland perches, where its diet consists primarily of beetles, crickets, scorpions, and small reptiles.
habitat: Cultivated farmland, scrub forests, and grassland perches
diet: Beetles, crickets, scorpions, and small reptiles
